author: SirFobaio
body:
Nick: SIrFobaio
Reason:  CombatLog

I was banned permanent by Combat Logging. Ban is correct, but it is wrong to be permanent because there are users with more than four tempban for this and only give them temporary ban. This was my quarter ban for this cause.
I want to apply a temporary ban, because the cause is right, but time no.

Thanks.

title: Wrong ban permanent

replies.author: ProfessorUtonium
replies.body:
Hello SirFobaio,

The ban that I have given is the correct timeframe if you refer to the New Punishment Guidelines, (https://avicus.net/forums/6f91bb10e) which states that having 4 Combat Log Punishments (which you have) is a Permanent Ban.

Regards,
Zerkk
Avicus Moderator.
